__comment: SEED / test-grade spec fixtures at Java identities (po-av01j.9): RC-019 timeouts and RC-022 retry-posture rationale on the G1 lane, RC-060 job-altitude re-application on the G3 lane (site_kinds), and a self-contained G4 emission section so the Java e2e needs only this file. PRODUCTION corpus authoring rides the LLM factory and is HITL (gate mint bead under po-av01j) - these entries exist so the e2e tests exercise real verdicts, nothing more. NOTE: there is no in-engine retry lane; RC-022 is carried as seed rationale on the identities where the retry decision lives (client construction / resilience decorators), recorded for the factory to expand. The java.util.Timer entry deliberately declares NO site_kinds: it is the classic-call-site control proving a G1 spec never decides a background_job site.

apis.rationale: SEED RC-019: a JDBC query blocks its thread until the driver returns; the bound is setQueryTimeout on the statement or a datasource-level socket/query timeout
SEED RC-019: HttpClient.send blocks; bounded by HttpRequest.timeout(...) per call or connectTimeout at the builder (connect phase only)

SEED RC-019 + RC-022 posture: Call.execute blocks; bounds live on the OkHttpClient.Builder (callTimeout/readTimeout), and retryOnConnectionFailure at the same builder is where the RC-022 retry decision lives
SEED RC-019: a Jedis command blocks on the socket; bounded by the connection/socket timeout at client construction

SEED RC-019 + RC-022 posture: RestTemplate blocks; bounds live on the request factory (connect/read timeout), and retries belong to a resilience decorator (@Retryable / resilience4j) around the call - the RC-022 surface for the factory to expand

SEED RC-060: a @Scheduled method runs unattended against shared stores; the registration is the altitude where a run bound must exist (a neighbouring bounding annotation such as @Transactional(timeout=...))
SEED applicability control: authored for classic call sites only (no site_kinds), so a background_job site with this api key must abstain, never inherit the judgment

emissions.rationale: a catch that neither emits nor re-throws swallows the failure: invisible to centralized error monitoring (RC-027)
a structured log emission on the error path feeds central log aggregation
structured log emission: minimal queryable telemetry
JUL emission feeds log aggregation when a handler ships it
sentry captures aggregate errors centrally with alerting
an OTel span at the I/O boundary carries trace context end to end
